HMLR_P2_UPDATED_20251013
The plan-preparation supplement was updated on 13 October 2025.
HMLR_P2_ENGLAND_WALES
The plan-preparation supplement applies to England and Wales.
HMLR_P2_OGL3
The guidance is licensed under Open Government Licence version 3.0 except where otherwise stated.
HMLR_DEED_PLANS_ESSENTIAL
Deed plans are described as an essential element of buying and selling land.
HMLR_TITLE_ACCURACY_LIMITED_BY_DEEDS
A title plan and register cannot describe land more accurately than the pre-registration deeds allow.
HMLR_DEEDS_FUTURE_BOUNDARY_ROLE
Pre-registration deeds can be crucial in resolving later boundary or extent questions.
HMLR_PLAN_IDENTIFY_OS_MAP
A lodged plan must allow the land to be clearly identified on the Ordnance Survey map.
HMLR_OS2_SAME_GUIDELINES
Plans lodged with an OS2 search of part are considered using the same transfer-or-lease-of-part guidelines.
HMLR_GUIDELINE_FAILURE_NOT_ALWAYS_FATAL
Failure to meet one or more plan guidelines does not automatically prevent an application proceeding.
HMLR_CONFIDENT_IDENTIFICATION_GATE
An application may proceed despite a guideline defect when HM Land Registry can still identify the land confidently.
HMLR_UNCLEAR_IDENTIFICATION_REJECTION
Land that cannot be clearly identified may cause rejection, requisition or later cancellation.
HMLR_TWO_TABLES
The supplement contains one table of acceptable-plan guidelines and another of common plan defects.
HMLR_GOOD_PLAN_BUYER_CLARITY
A good deed plan helps buyers understand what they bought.
HMLR_GOOD_PLAN_FUTURE_BASIS
A good deed plan provides a sound basis if later problems arise.
HMLR_GOOD_PLAN_EFFICIENT_PROCESSING
A good deed plan supports more efficient application processing.
HMLR_GOOD_PLAN_FEWER_REJECTIONS
A good deed plan reduces the likelihood of application rejection.
HMLR_LOCATION_AND_EXTENT_REQUIRED
Staff must identify both the location and the accurate extent of land in a registration-inducing deed or search.
HMLR_SHOW_SURROUNDING_FEATURES
The preferred plan normally shows the extent together with surrounding features and roads.
HMLR_SHOW_RIGHTS
The preferred plan also shows rights benefiting or burdening the land.
HMLR_UNUSUAL_APPLICATION_SAME_BASE_RULES
Unusual applications use fundamentally the same plan guidelines, with situation-specific variations.
HMLR_FIRST_REG_CLEAR_IDENTIFICATION
A first-registration application must include enough detail to identify the land clearly on the Ordnance Survey map.
HMLR_FIRST_REG_PLAN_USUALLY_NEEDED
A plan is required in most first-registration applications.
HMLR_POSTAL_DESCRIPTION_EXCEPTION
A clear postal description may occasionally suffice for a fully defined mapped house.
HMLR_OPEN_SIDE_PASSAGE_PLAN_REQUIRED
A verbal description is inadequate where open side passageways make the extent uncertain.
HMLR_OPEN_FRONTAGE_PLAN_REQUIRED
A verbal description is inadequate where an open-plan frontage makes the extent uncertain.
HMLR_UNDEFINED_REAR_GARDEN_PLAN_REQUIRED
A verbal description is inadequate where rear gardens are undefined.
HMLR_SEPARATE_BUILDING_PLAN_REQUIRED
A verbal description is inadequate where separate garages or buildings create uncertainty.
HMLR_SUBSTITUTED_PLAN_SIGNATURE
A substituted or amended first-registration plan must be signed by the parties.
HMLR_PART_TRANSFER_PLAN_USUALLY
A transfer or lease of part usually requires a plan.
HMLR_APPROVED_ESTATE_CURRENT_VERSION
A plan based on an approved estate plan must use its current approved version.
HMLR_PLOT_NUMBER_VERBAL_NOT_ACCEPTABLE
A verbal description using plot numbers on an approved estate plan is not acceptable.
HMLR_POSTAL_ADDRESS_VERBAL_NOT_ACCEPTABLE_ESTATE
A postal-address-only description is not acceptable where an approved estate plan governs the disposition.
HMLR_CLEAR_TITLE_REFERENCE_CAN_SUPPORT_WORDS
A verbal description may work when the seller's title plan already contains a clearly defined identifier.
HMLR_UNDEFINED_PART_REQUIRES_PLAN
A transfer or lease of an unreferenced part requires a new plan.
HMLR_SELLER_SIGN_PLAN
The seller or landlord must sign the transfer or lease plan.
HMLR_ALL_MULTIPLE_PLANS_SIGNED
Every plan in a multi-plan transfer or lease must be signed.
HMLR_MULTI_DISPOSITION_PLANS_SIGNED
Plans for extent, easements and retained land all require signatures when included.
HMLR_COMPANY_OFFICER_SIGNATURE
A company seller or landlord should have authorised officers sign the plans.
HMLR_EXECUTION_OFFICERS_AUTHORITY
Officers signing the execution clause are treated as having authority to sign the plans.
HMLR_UNUSUAL_EXTENT_AIRSPACE
Airspace is an example of an unusual registrable extent.
HMLR_UNUSUAL_EXTENT_ROOFSPACE
Roof-space is an example of an unusual registrable extent.
HMLR_UNUSUAL_EXTENT_TUNNEL
A tunnel is an example of an unusual registrable extent.
HMLR_STRATA_FREEHOLD_OR_LEASEHOLD
Airspace or subsoil strata may be registered as freehold or leasehold.
HMLR_STRATA_STANDALONE_OR_COMPONENT
A strata registration may stand alone or form part of another structure.
HMLR_AD_HOARDING_UNUSUAL_EXTENT
An advertising hoarding can constitute an unusual extent depending on its position.
HMLR_UNUSUAL_EXTENT_PLAN_INVARIABLE
Unusual-extent applications invariably require a plan.
HMLR_UNUSUAL_EXTENT_GROUND_RELATION
The plan must show how an unusual extent relates to existing ground-surface detail.
